notes.title: Dungeon of Trials second anniversary! Patch 2.1 to celebrate!
notes.content:
Hello fellow adventurers!

The second anniversary of Dungeon of Trials is approaching, and to celebrate, we're bringing you something new!

After receiving player feedback, we decided to release a patch to make the game more balanced and fun!

We noticed that indeed, some classes were much better than others (I'm looking at you Mage!). But don't worry, no characters will be "nerfed". With the new balance, we hope that underused classes can also shine (finally adventuring parties will remember the Warriors)! Below is a preview of the changes:

Warrior: will start with higher attack power, since at first they could barely deal with basic enemies (and so they were soon dropped after the first run…). Skills that grant “buffs” to allies will also be improved.

Mage: will start with a little more MP (despite being one of the best classes in the game, he is not very useful in the beginning due to his low energy reserve.)

Thief: will have a higher attack gain per level.

Priestess: will receive slightly more HP and Defense per level to compensate for low attack power. Healing skills will be improved a bit.

Monk: the idea behind the Monk was to have a character that was strong in the early stages of the game, because he is not dependent on equipment. But even so, the class ended up being overshadowed by the others. Monk will now receive a significant boost to all his stats at first level and stat gains per level (but still won't benefit from weapon upgrades as he doesn't use any).

Druid: Increased MP and Spell Damage gains per level. The skill “Cure Poison” will restore a little more HP.

Archer: This is perhaps the most versatile class in the game, and it's already pretty strong. She will get a small Attack boost at the first level to make her even stronger! =)

Sorceress: We noticed that having the lowest HP value in the game caused her to be left out a bit in the free DLC “Library of Norliet”. In this dungeon we recommend using characters with magical powers, and as the Mage has more HP, he ended up favored. So the starting HP and HP gain per level will be adjusted.

Knight: Initial HP and Defense will be increased. Attack gain per level will be increased.

Bard: Will receive a small boost to all starting stats. The skill “Healing Song” will restore a little more HP.

We hope that with these changes, the beginning of the game will be less frustrating for some players, and that the game in general will become much more fun. Once again, thank you all so much for the feedback we've received over the last two years, without you none of this would be possible! These changes go live on the anniversary of the Dungeon of Trials, June 25th! If you don't already have the game, now is a great time to get started! Dungeon of Trials will be reduced in price during the Steam Summer Sale! Come face this challenge! Good luck and have fun!

notes.title: Dungeon of Trials first anniversary! HUGE update to celebrate! Version 2.0!
notes.content:
Hello fellow adventurers!

Exactly one year ago, Dungeon of Trials was released. It was a great challenge, as it was our first commercial game. But thanks to your support, the game prospered and grew! Last month we had the 1.7 update, with a lot of quality of life improvements based on player feedback. Now, we offer you a completely new journey, entirely for free!

The version 2.0 of Dungeon of Trials now includes the "Library of Norliet" expansion! The game now is two times bigger!

This free DLC adds a completely new dungeon, created by Norliet, God of Magic. Face a series of challenges suited for powerful spellcasters!

Here you will find:

1 completely new dungeon, with 5 levels to explore
19 new enemy types! Some of them will wipe out your party for sure! Come prepared!
8 new spells! Wait, that's only 7, the 8th is used only by the final boss to make you cry!
17 new items! These consumables will be really useful in your quest!
1 completely new ending! (well, there are actually 4 new endings, but only one of them is the real one!)

This content is actually harder than the base content, so we recommend you to bring characters with at least level 3, and with reasonable equipment, to start exploring this new dungeon (or you will be wiped out in 2 minutes... or less!)

And again, thank you for your support! This was only possible thanks to you, that bought the game, and leaved your feedback in the steam reviews and in the community page. We are always looking to improve, and hope you enjoy the new content! If you don't have the game yet, give it a try! It is on sale right now, from June 24 to July 8! Good luck, and have fun!

notes.title: New update! Version 1.7!
notes.content:
Hello fellow adventures!

It's been almost a year since we released our first game on steam!
Working with software development during the pandemic was especially challenging, so we are happy to announce that our first update is finally here!
First, we would like to thank all our players: without you, this first update would not be possible.
Your reviews and comments has been taken in account, so, we are implementing the following additional content:

- New NPC: The Dimensional Merchant!
You can now find a special character inside the dungeon! He can be found in every floor (often a little hidden), and he is ready to buy and sell items!

- New Monster Drops!
LOOT! Finally! Normal monsters now have a small chance of dropping items. Those can be sold to the Dimensional Merchant, for EXTRA PROFIT!

- New consumables!
There are 11 new consumable items that will be crucial for your quest! One of them let you return to town instantly (no more dying to warp back to the guild!)! Aside from healing items, you can also get consumables that deal elemental damage to your enemies! Useful in those hard fights...and to make the warrior useful (hahaha, poor warriors...)!

The 1.7 update will be live at May 20! We will also be holding a special sale to celebrate the patch!

Oh, by the way, we still plan to release more additional content, for free!
We don't want to give spoilers right now...but our team is already working on a completely new dungeon for you to explore! Watch out for your next announcement to learn when there will be more content available!
